name: evaluateConcreteCategoryRules Function
description: This function is designed to run the callbacks on concreteCategories but is completely dead code. It is never imported, called, or referenced by the calculation engine or the front-end components.

name: Category validationRules and evaluate Callbacks
description: Each concrete category contains a 'validationRules' list with dynamic 'evaluate' callbacks. Because evaluateConcreteCategoryRules is dead code, none of these 20+ custom evaluation callbacks are ever executed. Instead, identical checks are performed by suitabilityGate.ts.

name: Water pH Range Limit (waterPHRange)
description: Defined under validationLimits as [6.5, 8.5], but is never checked in suitabilityGate.ts, validationGate.ts, or validateInputs.ts.

name: Maximum Water Chloride (maxWaterChloridePpm)
description: Defined as 500 ppm in validationLimits, but is never used anywhere in calculation or validation logic.

name: Maximum Water Sulphate (maxWaterSulphatePpm)
description: Defined as 2000 ppm in validationLimits, but is never checked or validated against user water inputs.

name: High Fiber Dosage Threshold (highFiberDosageThresholdKgM3)
description: Defined as 80.0 kg/m³ to flag excessive fiber dosages, but is completely unused in all engine validation gates.
